cells.gaps: No source found says a law, decree or regulation that sets a rule for AI is in force, or that the AI provisions of the 2024 cybercrimes bill survived into the Act.
cells.note: A wider bill that regulates AI among other matters is a draft: the Cybercrimes and Computer Misuse Bill 2024 carried proposed AI provisions in October 2025. No AI rule has been found in force.
